A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and support comparison of the complete text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Pages 2–44 are visually identical; changes concern the title page and Appendix E.

before.justification: v1 reports original sketch-generation experiments, Long-CLIP scores, user-preference studies, RL ablations, and qualitative results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds qualitative evaluations of unseen categories, unfamiliar part combinations, and poor-quality validation outputs.

M1.justification: The annotation pipeline, VLM inputs and outputs, SFT procedure, and multi-turn process-reward GRPO remain unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A. Self-evaluation and selective regeneration in Appendix E.3 are proposed future work, not implemented components.

E1.justification: Beyond the retained ControlSketch-Part evaluation, v2 adds qualitative tests covering 12 unseen object categories and unfamiliar object-part combinations, such as wings on a chair (Figs. A17–A18). This substantially extends reported coverage to category and compositional generalization; training coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: The comparisons with SketchAgent, Gemini 3.1 Pro, SDXL+SwiftSketch, and the SFT-only variant are unchanged, as are the RL ablation comparators. The new appendix evaluations introduce no additional comparison methods.

E3.justification: New qualitative analyses pair incomplete canvases with prescribed unfamiliar part additions and select the worst observed validation outputs for inspection. Appendix E also identifies some OOD examples as randomly selected from the test partition. Existing training schedules, model configurations, metrics, and user-study procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond the retained RL ablations and Fig. A16 failure cases, v2 adds unseen-category generalization tests, cross-category part-insertion tests, and a worst-output analysis spanning all in-distribution categories (Figs. A17–A19). These substantially broaden the robustness and error analyses.

E5.justification: There are no additions or revisions to repeated-run counts, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or significance testing. The new appendix examples do not quantify failure frequencies or statistical uncertainty.

E6.justification: Existing numerical results are unchanged, including the full model's 0.307 Long-CLIP score in Fig. 5. Figs. A17–A19 add substantial qualitative evidence: unseen objects can yield meaningless sketches or resemble familiar categories, some unseen objects are approximated successfully, unfamiliar part additions often fail, and severe in-distribution defects occur.

T1.justification: The GRPO reward and advantage definitions, learning objective, and KL estimator remain unchanged. The expanded appendix introduces no new mathematical definitions, formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about automated part annotation, ControlSketch-Part, multi-turn process-reward GRPO, and controllable, locally editable sketch generation.

C2.justification: v1 briefly acknowledges limited category coverage and error accumulation. v2 substantially develops the applicability boundaries, discusses substitution toward familiar categories and failures on unfamiliar parts, and attributes severe defects to coordinate-prediction difficulty and sampling stochasticity. It also proposes greater data diversity and self-evaluation as possible remedies; these explanations are not experimentally isolated.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page URL on the title page and provides explicit unfamiliar-part prompts in Fig. A18. Existing implementation settings and annotation templates are unchanged. The supplied PDFs do not establish that code or data have been released through the new link.

R1.justification: The related-work section and reference list are unchanged. The revision introduces no new cited works or substantive changes to the paper's novelty positioning.

P1.justification: Rewriting and expansion are localized to Appendix E.2, with an additional future-work paragraph in E.3 and a title-page link. The main narrative, terminology, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds the unseen-category montage in Fig. A17, paired part-insertion examples in Fig. A18, and the three-page Fig. A19 gallery. These are localized additions; existing figures and tables are retained, with slight title-page reflow around the new URL.

improvement.justification: Appendix E replaces a brief coverage caveat with concrete evidence of generalization failures and poor outputs, helping readers judge the method's applicability. This improves transparency without weakening the retained experimental evidence. The overall gain is limited because the additions are qualitative, failure frequencies and proposed causes remain untested, and the main technical and quantitative content is unchanged.
